scope: Explicitly requested simple test message from each configured provider; no invoice, XML or attachment.

sources.evidence: POST /smtp/email request body declares attachment without making it mandatory. Existing sender/to/subject/text fields are unchanged.
Official smtpSendMail serializes the supplied email object; attachments are not added or required by this adapter. Existing OAuth, PHP serialization and HTML encoding are unchanged.
Send API v3.1 supports simple messages with From, To, Subject and TextPart; attachment fields are optional.

policy.authorization: User explicitly requested one test per Brevo, SendPulse and Mailjet to the personal destination supplied in the conversation. Personal address is not stored in this repository.
policy.recipient: Verified account mailbox or the server-configured NFSE_EMAIL_TEST_TO, selected through authenticated owner context. No arbitrary client destination.
policy.dispatch: Sequential, one durable intent per test, one request per tenant per rolling 24h; exactly one independent message per provider, no retries or fallback.
policy.limits: Same private attempt ledger, rolling caps 300/400/200 and global exclusion as invoice mail. SendPulse minimum spacing stays 75 seconds; no long wait inside Vercel.
policy.delivery: Provider acceptance does not prove inbox delivery. Expiration after intent and ambiguous responses remain uncertain, without automatic retransmission.

limits: Public sources and synthetic HTTP/SQL/UI tests only. No live credentials, authenticated production session or administrative database connection are available in the executor; no real test email was sent.
